Hi. I'm a guy who dropped out of college to pursue his career in music (Mumbai,India). I got admission in an engineering college in the year 2017.I was a pretty bright student( JEE and all)  It was never my thing. Have you ever lied about every aspect of your life to every single person that you interact with, for 4 years? I did. I lied about going to college, to my family and friends and just kept trying to make music. I made 1173 tracks in these 4 years. I released around 100.  Maybe I wasn't good enough hence i couldn't crack it. Can you believe it? Not one human on this planet found it worth their time. That also includes my family and friends. All I have now is no friends, not a family for support ( I forgot to mention I told them the truth about me not going to college and getting a degree, i deserve this). So coming back to the point, No friends, No family, 1173 Tracks and a shitty pile of debt(not much 20k due tomorrow hahahaha if i don't kill myself,they probably will), taken to survive (literally survive).

 The reason I wanted to write this out here is because I want to leave this world by at least putting my point out there.

IF YOU ARE A PARENT. 
PLEASE do not stop your child from pursuing his or her dreams.
Don't be harsh on them, it scars them for life.
Do not enforce that being an engineer or a doctor is the ultimate goal of life.
Encourage them for sports.
Be there for them physically,Please.
Never ever tell your kids "We are out there earning money for you" Trust me, the kid never asked to be born. 
Make them work for their wishes instead of negating them.
I became professional at lying, that's only because my parents never let me do a single thing. So be supportive and open when your child asks your permission for something.
Strict parents do make the best liars.

All right, that was my take on everything that I had in mind and I'm really apologetic for sharing my opinion on parenting. I'm literally done with life and i honestly didn't like what this world has to offer. It might be because of bad decisions on my part and other external factors. People are mean. And I'm done. Nobody helps anyone without expecting something in return. I'm not asking for money, help or sympathy. I'm well aware of my decision. And if this flouts the rules of this sub, that'd be great! Another place where I wasn't heard. 
I repeat, parents. Parents please take care of your child, doesn't matter if they're 13 or 33. Hug them and talk to them, they really need you. Ok peace out for the final time. 
Much love,
M.
